description:
Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 allowance a holder granted a spender. Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 allowance: how much spender may move of owner token balance. Takes token (ERC-20 contract), owner and spender addresses; returns the allowance read live from the contract.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_erc20_allowance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_erc20_allowance
